title: Web3 Social Crowdfunding Platform
tagline: A Web3 Social Crowdfunding Platform mainly focuses on social cause.
description: I've decided to build a Web3 crowdfunding platform solely focuses on non profit social cause that can create a positive impact to the world. Everyone can start a campaign related to social cause like environment, education, medical treatment, animal and so on without any hassle.
how_its_made:
Technologies used:
IPFS: Upload and retrieve campaign details
Superfluid: Stream recurring funding to campaign
XMTP: Chat
Unstoppable Domain: Ease sign in flow
NFT Port: Fetch NFT
Covalent: Fetch ERC20 Balance
Polygon: Deploy smart contract
SKALE: Deploy smart contract(error, decided not to include)
